# Results — generated, do not edit

Everything here is overwritten by the scripts. Read in this order:

1. `r7_reference_architecture_report.md` — the main report
2. `r7_main_component_requirement_comparison.md` — baseline vs refined, side by side
3. `r7_controlled_comparison.md` — the controlled experiment and its limits

The CSVs behind them:

| File | One row per |
|---|---|
| `reference_requirement_coverage.csv` | configuration — **the headline verdict** |
| `reference_criterion_assessment.csv` | configuration x check, with rationale and evidence |
| `reference_capability_coverage.csv` | configuration x capability |
| `reference_component_coverage.csv` | configuration x component |
| `r7_variation_experiment.csv` | profile x configuration x test case |
| `r7_variation_experiment_summary.csv` | profile x configuration |
| `proposed_*_test_results.csv` | proposed-model test case (T1–T10) |
